rules.initialization: Only runtime change is resource_id::text AS cursor. Existing cursor field/keyset order/filter/limit/version/force and transactional invalidation/builders remain unchanged. Existing scoped PG13 runner already maps journey source changes and executes the full native digital-journey schema, now including startup registration and consumption. The new first case creates a native source and native two-PO order in its owned schema, removes only their native dirty rows to require startup backfill, pages1+1+empty, proves no eager model construction, consumes2 and verifies ready models, demands100/200 and idempotent empty follow-up. Actual PG13.23 server uses cached image binaries in private /tmp to avoid shared-vfs disk allocation; stopped after checks. First local35assertions passed but teardown failed53200 due privately reduced30connection lock budget; retained failed evidence, restored original image100connection budget and repeated only that affected suite. rules.dateAndPermission: No schema, role, authorization, dates/SLA, frozen calculation version, source-to-order ownership, version comparison, old/new dirty registration, page/KPI scope or retries change. Actual13.23 query reproduces old42601 and fixed startup runs with NOSUPERUSER/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE/NOBYPASSRLS app role on marked TEST database. Existing PG16 full native fact-update suite retains rollback, concurrent/late transaction, failed-object isolation and same-snapshot freshness. No onsite rows/configs/credentials read or changed; optional generic runtime logging enhancement deferred to keep urgent repair narrow.
